rule_fixed_before_harmonization: 统一规则（阅读前写死）：核心答案=回答中最后一个明确结论。最后结论与 expected_answer 一致→follows_fact；与 other_fact_answer 一致→other_fact；其他具体答案→other_wrong；最后结论是“无法确定/题目矛盾/不能回答”→other_wrong；回答在给出任何最终结论前中断且出现了相互冲突的候选→unclear；没有任何可判定答案（空、乱码、跑题、只复述题目、中断前未出现答案）→not_delivered。contradiction=回答中出现相互冲突的核心结论（如先答错再改对、先说无法确定再算出答案）；repetition=明显循环重复。
first_reading: 12 model-assisted blind readers (Claude subagents), one per packet; methods varied on self-correcting answers

pass1.selected: unclear, contradiction=true, or other_wrong with an unanswerability note

pass2.selected: not_delivered with refusal/unanswerability note (gap found through second-reading disagreements)

second_reading.readers: two independent blind model readers who never saw first labels

adjudication.by: orchestrating model (Claude), blind to the key, applying the fixed rule

disclosure: all reading is model-assisted; no human reader; not an independent replication
